name: mscse-thesis-direction
description: The thesis option's own registration, CSE 68901, satisfies §3.2's six project/thesis credits. §3.2 names both courses by number — "six (6) credit hours of Masters project (CSE 68902) or Masters thesis direction (CSE 68901)" — so for the MSCSE the ID decides and the Courses tab's course_type cell does not (DGS 2026-09-11: "Ignore the course type"). The fixture types CSE 68901 as `research`, mirroring the live sheet, which is exactly the cell that used to leave every thesis student reading "0 of 6" beside a row telling them to register for CSE 68901. A mix of the two ids counts too.

CSE 68901: counts toward the project/thesis requirement (3 cr)
CSE 68902: counts toward the project/thesis requirement (3 cr)
